description: Connect MedGroup to query DRG/DIP cities and rules, search ICD codes, perform grouping and settlement scenario calculations, and check CC/MCC status.

display.description_en: Connect MedGroup to query DRG/DIP cities and rules, search ICD codes, perform grouping and settlement scenario calculations, and check CC/MCC status.
display.description_zh: 连接 MedGroup，查询 DRG/DIP 城市与规则、检索 ICD 编码、完成分组、结算测算及 CC/MCC 查询。
examples_en: List the DRG/DIP cities and rule versions currently supported by MedGroup
Search pneumonia ICD-10 codes and, after confirmation, perform DRG grouping for a selected city
Check whether a case satisfies a specified DIP rule and cite the tool that was actually called
Check CC/MCC and exclusion status for secondary diagnoses under a selected city rule
examples_zh: 查看 MedGroup 当前支持的 DRG/DIP 城市与规则版本
检索肺炎相关 ICD-10 编码，确认后按指定城市执行 DRG 分组
核对某个 DIP 病种规则，并说明本次实际调用的工具
查询其他诊断在指定城市规则下的 CC/MCC 与排除状态
